dialogues.speaker: Wolsey
dialogues.text: It was broken even before work stopped at the Geode Mine Shaft, so there was even less reason to fix it afterwards. As a result, it was just sitting there, broken, in the abandoned production zone, for who knows how long...

dialogues.speaker: Wolsey
dialogues.text: After Camden started complaining about the strange sounds it was making disturbing his naps, I brought it back here to fix it up. Then I found a job for it.

dialogues.speaker: Wolsey
dialogues.text: I'm quite the mechanic, you know. I bet I could teach those kids at the Fontaine Research Institute a thing or two.
